Over the last few months we optimized the llama.cpp CI to keep up with the fast pace of development

- We now use HF Buckets to store most of our Github Actions cache
- We use HF Jobs to enroll additional CI runners

More info in this blog post:
posts.card: How we optimized our workflows and overcame GitHub Actions limitations
